## Checklist

- [ ] One topic only.
- [ ] Sentence case headings; a full stop on every bullet.
- [ ] Links are relative, not absolute `github.com` URLs.
- [ ] Photos (if any): correct `images/` folder, `scripts/optimize-images.py` run, `.jpg`, no
      spaces or parentheses in filenames, real caption, plain markdown — no `<img>` tags.
- [ ] Photos are mine, or I have permission to publish them here.
- [ ] No plan sheets, CAD files or DXFs. Quoting a dimension to report an error is fine.
- [ ] I haven't touched the affiliate links.
